xs.$description: The tightest corner — swatches, colour chips, inline markers. 2px.

sm.$description: 4px. Inputs, buttons and selects at xs/sm; badges, tooltips, kbd, menu items.

chip.$description:
The resting corner of a small labelled mark — pills, badges, chips. 4px, the same value as `radius-sm` today.

IT IS NOT AN ALIAS OVER `radius-sm`, WHICH IS THE ONLY REASON IT EXISTS. `--radius-control`, `--radius-card`, `--radius-surface` and `--radius-overlay` were all deprecated by `radius-roles-to-scale` for being exactly that — one name in front of one scale step, carrying no decision of its own. This one DIVERGES: under the `round` corner language it takes `--radius-pill` and the chip family becomes capsules, which no step on the xs/sm/md/lg ramp can say. Under `flat` and `soft` it tracks `radius-sm` exactly, so those themes are byte-identical to before it existed.

WHY IT IS A ROLE AND NOT A COMPONENT HOOK: three components read it (`esa-pill`, `esa-badge`, `esa-chip-group`) and they are meant to agree — esa-pill's own note says its 4px corner exists to match esa-badge. A per-component hook would let them drift apart silently, which is the failure the 2026-08-16 tier-3 demotion pass removed 168 instances of.

It does NOT cover `esa-pill shape="round"`, which is an explicit per-instance opt-in and stays on `--radius-pill` under every corner language.

md.$description: 8px, the default corner and the most-used step — inputs, buttons and selects at md/lg; dropdowns, popovers, panels, cards, alerts, snackbars. Re-point this to make a theme flatter or rounder overall.

lg.$description: 12px. Things that float above the page — dialogs, confirm dialogs, the command palette, entity search.

pill.$description: Fully rounded — avatars, progress bars, filter pills, breadcrumb pills, the back-to-top button. NOT a step on the scale: it is a shape, and it stays a named role so a squared-off brand can re-point it to --radius-sm without touching the ramp.
